answer:
I found TX-0401 on account ACC-1005 (EUR):

- **Amount:** EUR 240.00 (confirmed)
- **Merchant:** TechMart Online
- **Date:** 2026-07-20
- **Type:** Card payment, outgoing, settled

I also see TX-0402, dated 2026-07-14, for the same EUR 240.00 at TechMart Online. I'm only noting that the two payments match; I haven't determined whether either one is a problem.

These reason codes exist for card payments. Each has a dispute window counted from the transaction date:

| Reason code | Use when | Window |
|---|---|---|
| duplicate_charge | You were charged more than once for the same purchase | 60 days |
| unauthorized_debit | You did not authorize the payment | 56 days |
| fraud_card_not_present | Your card details were used fraudulently in an online or phone transaction | 120 days |
| goods_not_received | You paid, but the goods were never delivered | 90 days |
| service_not_rendered | You paid, but the service was never provided | 90 days |

For TX-0401 (dated 2026-07-20), the windows close roughly as follows: unauthorized_debit about 2026-09-14, duplicate_charge about 2026-09-18, goods_not_received and service_not_rendered about 2026-10-18, and fraud_card_not_present about 2026-11-17. Those dates are my calculation, so please treat them as approximate. Eligibility is checked when a dispute is opened.

Tell me what happened with this payment, and I can check whether a dispute under the matching code is eligible. I won't open anything until you confirm.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Notifications
## Dispute updates
A dispute generates a notification on every state change. The notification
names the state, never the internal reason for a decision.
